verdicts.reason: A keeps the product badge, headline, subcopy and CTA intact, but everything sits in the top half and the bottom ~45% of the canvas is empty. It still reads like a stretched banner rather than a rearranged layout, and the Try It button floats to the right without lining up with the text column. B breaks the product art: the cream circle has come loose and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, and the can body is orange on the orange background, so only a faint outline is left. The headline is also too small for the canvas, and the NEW badge is stranded in the top-right corner away from the product.
